jobs.title: Director of Customer Success
jobs.description:
About Sirona Medical

At  Sirona Medical , we’re building software that enables physicians to work as fast as they can think.

Each year in the U.S.,  billions of patient images  are captured—and nearly all of them are reviewed and diagnosed by radiologists. These specialists are the central hub of diagnostic medicine:  over 80% of all healthcare data flows through radiology IT systems . Yet despite their pivotal role, radiologists are overburdened by outdated, fragmented software which limits their efficiency and ultimately the quality and efficiency of care that health systems can provide patients. That’s where Sirona comes in.

We’re a  San Francisco-based, cloud-native software company  with employees around the world. Our deep understanding of both the  practice and business of radiology  has allowed us to build  RadOS —a unified, AI-powered operating system powering the entire radiology workflows.

How Sirona Solves the Problem

Sirona is  uniquely positioned to transform the way radiology is practiced . We're delivering the organizational shift that both individual radiologists and entire practices urgently need:

-
A  unified , intuitive, and  platform-agnostic  solution

-
A streamlined workspace that makes  every part of the radiologist’s workflow faster and easier

-
The freedom to  read from anywhere, for anyone

By cutting clicks, optimizing diagnostic time, and unlocking efficiencies that extend  far beyond the reading room into all care settings , Sirona empowers radiologists—and in doing so, we help the entire healthcare system move faster, smarter, and with greater impact on patient outcomes.

For more information, please visit https://sironamedical.com/join/ .

Director of Customer Success

About the Role
The Director of Customer Success will own the strategic framework for keeping Sirona's existing radiology customers engaged, retained, and expanding and will partner closely with Go-To-Market and Implementation on onboarding new customers. This is an individual-contributor hands-on leadership role today, with no direct reports initially.  As the customer base and team grow, this role is expected to build and lead the Customer Success function. You'll report to the VP of Client Services.

This role requires deep expertise in radiology customer workflows and customer success strategy, along with the judgment to build a durable process without a team to lean on yet.

Key Responsibilities:

- Define the CS strategy for Sirona: engagement playbooks, customer health scoring, and success metrics

- Own the customer relationship post-go-live - retention, adoption, and expansion - for our existing customer base

- Partner with GTM/Sales during pre-close and implementation to ensure new customers are set up for a strong launch

- Foster alignment across Product, Implementations, Support, and Sales to deliver a unified customer experience

- Represent the customer voice in roadmap discussions and executive business reviews

- Own metrics such as NRR, renewal rate, and customer engagement dashboards

- Drive executive relationships with key accounts and strategic radiology partners

- Lay the groundwork (process, tooling, hiring plan) for a Customer Success team as the function scales

How You'll Be Measured

- Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and Renewal Rate

- Expansion conversion and advocacy metrics

- Customer satisfaction and health score trends

- Proactive issue resolution and escalation management

Key Requirements:

- 7+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or related fields, ideally in SaaS delivered radiology PACS and reporting

- 3+ years of direct experience in radiology or imaging informatics, with a strong understanding of radiologist workflows, strongly preferred

- 2+ years of experience managing managers required. This role starts as an individual contributor but is expected to scale into a multi-layer team

- Proven track record building or maturing customer success programs from the ground up, comfortable operating without an existing team or established process

- Strategic mindset, strong operational rigor, and excellent communication and executive presence

Benefits:

- Generous Compensation Plan

- Stock Options

- Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)

- Medical, dental, vision insurance

- Life insurance

- Maternity and Paternity Leave

- 401K matching

- Apple equipment

- Sponsorship for conferences, continuing education, etc.

The annual US base salary for this full-time position is $180,000 - $200,000 + equity + benefits. Pay scale is flexible depending on experience. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, competencies, experience, relevant education and training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Sirona Marketing Manager Role Summary

Sirona is looking for a hands-on, full-stack marketer who becomes the day-to-day engine behind how Sirona shows up in the market and how we turn attention into pipeline. The role spans three concentrations: social media (owning our channels end to end), general content creation (across formats), and paid media (running our Google and LinkedIn programs). Just as important, this is a people-facing role.  This person will be a personable partner who helps plan, promote, and run our webinars and events alongside the Director of Marketing Operations. This includes  showing up in person when needed.

We are an AI-native marketing team. This role will use AI tools every day to create, scale, and measure their work, and is excited to keep learning as the tooling evolves. This will will create on-brand content at a steady cadence, run an active and engaged social presence, produce video and graphics in-house, and manage paid campaigns against a spend-to-pipeline target. We will hire a versatile doer who turns Sirona's story into a consistent, always-on stream of brand and demand.

Key Responsibilities:

- Social channels. Own Sirona's presence end to end — LinkedIn first, plus emerging channels: calendar, publishing, community management, and active engagement with companies, partners, and people in radiology

- Content creation - Produce social posts, short-form video, graphics, blog/newsletter support, and campaign creative — on-brand and on-voice, across formats and at a steady cadence

- Webinars & events - Help plan and run Sirona's webinars and events end to end, hand in hand with Jenna — topic and speaker planning, presenter prep, production and platform logistics, live moderation/hosting, and post-event follow-up. Drive attendance through organic and paid promotion, attend events in person, capture content on site, and repurpose it afterward. A personable, on-camera-comfortable presence who's genuinely good with people

- Paid media - Build, launch, and optimize paid campaigns across Google Ads (search) and LinkedIn (and emerging channels): audience and creative setup, budget pacing, A/B testing, and weekly reporting on spend → MQL → opportunity → pipeline against target

- Work AI-first - Use AI tools to draft, produce, and scale content, creative, and analysis — and help push how our AI-native marketing team works. We give you the tools; we expect you to run with them and keep leveling up

- Videography - Shoot and edit video in-house — event capture, customer and product moments, social clips, and thought-leadership pieces. Light editing is expected day to day. May require travel

-  Brand consistency - Keep every asset aligned to the Sirona design system and voice

Key Requirements:

- 3–5 years in marketing for a B2B brand (health-tech, SaaS, or a comparable regulated/technical space a plus), with hands-on ownership across social, content, and paid

- AI-fluent — already uses AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, generative image/video, AI in the marketing stack) in day-to-day work, or a fast, eager learner who is genuinely excited to work on an AI-native team

- Personable and people-facing — comfortable on camera, hosting or moderating webinars, and representing Sirona in person at events. Enjoys working closely with a small team

- Hands-on content creator — writing plus visual/video; a portfolio or live channels that show range

- Direct experience running paid media in Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager — building campaigns, managing budget, and reporting on cost-per-lead and downstream conversion (not just vanity metrics)

- Experience promoting and helping run webinars and events, and comfortable with the logistics of both

- Proficient shooting and editing video (e.g. Premiere / CapCut / equivalent) and with design tools (e.g. Canva / Adobe)

- Native fluency in LinkedIn and social best practice; comfortable engaging publicly in Sirona's voice

- Organized and self-directed — can run a content calendar and a campaign calendar in parallel and juggle multiple deliverables without close supervision

- Willing and able to travel to events as needed

- Excellent project management and cross-functional  communication skills

Nice to have:

- Radiology, medical imaging, or healthcare-IT familiarity

- Hands-on experience with AI content/creative tools (generative image and video, AI copy, AI-assisted editing) and using AI to speed up analysis and reporting

- Marketing automation (HubSpot) and analytics (GA4, LinkedIn/Google reporting) fluency; comfort tying campaigns to CRM

- Webinar platforms (Zoom Webinars, ON24) hands-on experience

- Motion graphics / animation; photography

- SEO / landing-page conversion instinct.

Benefits:

- Generous Compensation Plan

- Stock Options

- Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)

- Medical, dental, vision insurance

- Life insurance

- Maternity and Paternity Leave

- 401K matching

- Apple equipment

- Sponsorship for conferences, continuing education, etc.

The annual US base salary range for this full-time position is $85,000 - $110,000 + equity + benefits. Pay scale is flexible depending on experience. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, competencies, experience, relevant education and training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.
